theorems.name: Submission.whitney_gluing_continuousAt_fderiv
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Set (Rn n)) (h : Rn n → ℝ) (ν : Rn n → Rn n) (ι : Type) (φ : ι → Rn n → ℝ) (p : ι → Rn n) (C M : ℝ) (g : Rn n → ℝ), IsClosed A → ContinuousOn ν A → (∀ K ⊆ A, IsCompact K → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ A, 0 < ‖y - x‖ → ‖y - x‖ < δ → |h y - h x - inner ℝ (ν x) (y - x)| ≤ ε * ‖y - x‖) → 0 ≤ C → 0 ≤ M → (∀ i, p i ∈ A) → (∀ x ∈ A, fderiv ℝ g x = innerSL ℝ (ν x)) → (∀ x ∉ A, ∃ S : Finset ι, (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ φ i x ∧ ‖x - p i‖ ≤ C * Metric.infDist x A) ∧ ∑ i ∈ S, φ i x = 1 ∧ ∑ i ∈ S, fderiv ℝ (φ i) x = 0 ∧ (Metric.infDist x A ≤ 1 → ∑ i ∈ S, ‖fderiv ℝ (φ i) x‖ ≤ M / Metric.infDist x A) ∧ fderiv ℝ g x = ∑ i ∈ S, (φ i x • innerSL ℝ (ν (p i)) + (h (p i) + inner ℝ (ν (p i)) (x - p i)) • fderiv ℝ (φ i) x)) → ∀ a ∈ A, ContinuousAt (fderiv ℝ g) a
